jobs.name: Jordi Turull
jobs.prompt:
Create a NEW SINGLE individual professional TCG trading-card character illustration of Jordi Turull, a Spanish politician. Exact 3:4 portrait canvas, full bleed; ONE PERSON ONLY.

IDENTITY: reference 1 contains four people. ONLY the BOTTOM LEFT person is Jordi Turull. Preserve that exact recognizable face, age, hair, glasses and facial hair. Do not borrow faces or fragments from any other quadrant. Reference 2 (Barack Obama) guides ONLY the original120 TCG digital-painting style, framing and visible chest-up proportions, never Obama's face or American imagery.

COMPOSITION: repaint one coherent scene from scratch; not a crop, montage, atlas, grid, pasted photograph, inset rectangle or resized portrait over a colored background. Like the Obama reference, show full hair, both complete shoulders, neck and chest, with moderate genuine background above and beside the figure. Hair begins approximately 14–18% from the top, chin around 52–55%; natural hair-to-chin head height about 36–40% of the whole canvas. The subject should have similar visual weight to Obama, neither a huge close-up nor a distant waist-up/full-body figure. No artificial margins or padding. Fill every edge with a continuous background.

POSE: charismatic natural orator expression appropriate to this person. Preserve the selected reference person's natural off-camera head AND eye direction together, about 10–20 degrees; do not rotate the head one way but leave eyes glancing back toward the viewer. If the selected reference is looking directly at the camera, gently turn BOTH head and pupils together toward viewer's right. Never look into the lens and never force an exaggerated profile. Preserve individual character and vary poses organically. Keep the clothes of the selected reference quadrant, with tailored formality suitable for raro tier. If the selected person has lectern microphones, retain one or two low in the frame without blocking the face.

BACKGROUND: retain the party/institutional setting of ONLY the selected target quadrant. Repaint its parliamentary, senatorial, ministerial or party surroundings as a continuous richly lit architectural scene, not a solid color or an artificial gradient filling space around a shrunken image. Preserve genuine emblems or short authentic marks if present in that target's background. Do not invent political groups, affiliations, party acronyms, long labels or explanatory text; do not copy another quadrant's institutional signage. No other people, faces, hands, shoulders, seams or strips from another image anywhere, including the edges.

STYLE: polished semi-realistic TCG digital illustration, dramatic studio lighting, rich detailed digital painting and charismatic stage presence like the original120 reference; not a flat corporate headshot or passport photo. Quiet lower corners for UI. No card frame, captions, names, stats, UI, watermark or collage. Output EXACTLY 3:4.

visualReview.scope: Composición, mirada, entorno y bordes comprobados en cartas reales; no certifica identidad fotográfica.
